Package neqsim.process.diagnostics

Class ProcessBalanceDiagnosis

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.diagnostics.ProcessBalanceDiagnosis
public final class ProcessBalanceDiagnosis extends Object
Screens single flowmeter biases and unmetered outflows against synchronized inventory balances. Control volumes are identified by their inventory signal (kg). Meters are oriented edges (kg/s). Each candidate must explain every control volume within its absolute error budget.

  • Method Details

    • assess

      public static ProcessBalanceDiagnosis assess(RcaProcessWindow window, Map<String,Double> inventoryChangeBoundsKg, List<ProcessBalanceDiagnosis.Meter> meters)
      Integrates instantaneous meter readings by the trapezoidal rule over the common window. Bounds add conservatively, including systematic errors. The inventory-change budget may include model, synchronization and quadrature allowances expressed in kg.
      Parameters:
      window - synchronized, equally spaced samples with common start and end times
      inventoryChangeBoundsKg - maximum absolute error in each inventory change, in kg
      meters - all measured boundary flows, each supplied once
      Returns:
      evidence and all surviving single-fault candidates
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid budgets, topology, samples or numerical overflow
